comparison.objective: Tighten a castle nut to align the next slot, then insert a cotter pin; the candidate adjusts a stop screw and tightens its jam nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Single-tool nut rotation followed by pin alignment/insertion; candidate requires simultaneous screw counterholding against locknut reaction.
comparison.success_condition: Nut must move only in the tightening direction until a slot aligns and the cotter pin passes through; candidate requires preserved 90° setting and three-cycle retention.
comparison.reason: This is the closest threaded record, but it tests safe further tightening plus pinning, not coupled screw-and-jam-nut locking without setting drift.
